name: RewardBench 2
intro: RewardBench 2是一个全新的多技能奖励建模基准，旨在通过提供更具挑战性的数据来推进奖励模型的评估。与第一代相比，模型在RewardBench 2上的得分平均低20分，但与下游任务性能高度相关。该基准使用新的人类提示，而非现有评估中的提示，从而实现了更严格的评估。
org: Allen Institute for AI, University of Washington, Cohere
build_method: WildChat 真人提示采集、分类与去污染；多模型回答生成；领域专属自动与人工过滤
task_type: 选择题, 排序, 对话
eval_feature: 四选一奖励模型评测；六领域无权平均；Ties 分布感知评分
build_method_en: WildChat human-prompt sourcing, classification and decontamination; multi-model completion generation; domain-specific automated and manual filtering
eval_feature_en: Best-of-four reward-model evaluation, unweighted six-domain mean, and distribution-aware Ties scoring
intro_en: RewardBench 2 is a new multi-skill reward modeling benchmark designed to advance reward model evaluation by providing more challenging data. Compared to the first generation, model scores on RewardBench 2 are on average 20 points lower but show a high correlation with downstream task performance. The benchmark uses new human prompts instead of those from existing evaluations, enabling a more rigorous assessment.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with RewardBench 2 arXiv:2506.01937 Section 3 and Appendices G-I, cross-checked against allenai/reward-bench. RewardBench 2 is an accuracy-based reward-model benchmark built from about 3,000 candidate prompts and finalized as 1,865 prompts across Factuality, Precise Instruction Following, Math, Safety, Focus, and Ties. Seventy percent are previously unused human prompts from WildChat; QuRater, a topic classifier, manual inspection, and Tulu 3 decontamination against 20 downstream evaluations are applied before completions from 20 models or humans are filtered with domain-specific judges, verifiers, voting, rubrics, and manual checks. Most items contain one chosen and three rejected completions. Five domains use best-of-four accuracy, Ties uses a distribution-aware score, and the overall score is the unweighted mean of six domains.
